name: Panagiotis Praftsas
bio: Panagiotis is an MSc student in Environmental Science (Chemistry, Toxicology and Health) at the University of Copenhagen, working on environmental microbiology, PFAS, and microbial biofilms. His project isolates strains from a TFA-degrading microbial community, verifying purity by Nanopore sequencing, and examines biofilm phenotypes via crystal violet assays and microscopy, laying groundwork for a thesis on how PFAS-site bacteria respond to exposure.
